items.title: Jane Ira Bloom interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 3, 1998
items.q: And your husband is Joe Grafasi? Did I pronounce that right?

ctx.x: Yeah. He has a tremendous gift for music. He sat down and he knew exactly where the musical energy should be and where it should be directed. It was quite wonderful to work with him.
